Name: Relax in the Saloon
Author: Sable17
Description:
[size=4][quote]Hey Gus! Hey Pam![/quote][/size]
[b]Sit in [u]any[/u] seat in the Saloon and get some small benefits:
[/b]
• Regen[b] 1 Energy [/b]per second.
-For comparison: [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Spa]The Spa [/url]regenerates 10 HP + 10 Energy per second. Spa isn't obsolete and is still a better option for pure regen.

• Gain[b] 1 friendship points[/b] every [b]10 in-game minutes[/b] with [b]EVERY[/b] [b]NPC[/b] currently in the Saloon, as long as you remain seated.
-For comparison: [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Friendship]Talking [/url]to an NPC each day rewards 20 friendship points. So not overpowered.

• Small note emote will play over your head when the regen starts.

• Small notes will randomly appear over NPCs head. Purely for fun.

[b]Things editable in the config:[/b]
• EnergyPerSecond (Default: 1)
• FriendshipEveryXMinutes (Default: 10)
• FriendshipPointsPerAward (Default: 1)
• NpcAmbientNotesEnabled (Default: true)

[b]Requirements[/b]
• Stardew Valley 1.6+  
• SMAPI  

(Mods in screenshot: Immersive Saloon, Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn, VPR-Inspired UI, Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic}
